newsitem.title: UK: London BFI rises 12 to 1,323, Panamaxes strong.
newsitem.headline: London BFI rises 12 to 1,323, Panamaxes strong.

text.p: Panamaxes again claimed the spotlight on the freight market on Friday.
South Korean charterers paid a significantly higher $24.10 no combination for Banya 52/54,000 hss U.S. Gulf/Japan for end-November.
The most modern Panamaxes have now been fixed at around $13,000 daily basis delivery Continent via U.S. Gulf to the Far East.
In the North Pacific there were rumours of modern Panamax tonnage paid in excess of $12,000 daily for a north Pacific round, up about $1,000 daily from Thursday's reported levels.
Rates for Capers and handisizes remained largely unchanged.
